divergence_justification: Equivalence judge accepted the contested 8-row divergence (7 intime_hr and 1 outtime_hr; 8/73,181 = 0.011%) as intrinsic upstream MIMIC-on-FHIR transformation loss. mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_chartevents.sql:9 casts source chartevents.charttime through TIMESTAMPTZ and line 67 writes Observation.effectiveDateTime, so spring-forward-gap 02:mm values become 03:mm; MIN after this many-to-one transformation can select a genuine 03:00/03:02 row, and the original wall time is unrecoverable from FHIR. Observation.id is opaque and UUID reconstruction is forbidden. Schema and row identity matched, 73,173/73,181 rows were identical, and the localized endpoint loss is ancillary: it changes no row inclusion, key, grouping, carry-forward, or clinical branch.
